interface.name: zwwm_tags_v1
interface.description: A tag is identified by its stable unsigned integer id. The compositor sends the complete current tag list followed by done after binding and after each change to that list. Global visibility is compositor policy.

request.name: get_toplevel_tags
request.description: The toplevel must be visible to this manager binding.

request.name: set_active_tags

description.summary: select tags visible on the focused output

request.description: The tags array contains packed uint32 tag ids. An empty array is valid and requests that no tagged toplevels are visible.

request.name: set_toplevel_tags
request.description: The tags array contains packed uint32 tag ids. The compositor validates ids before applying the complete replacement.

event.name: tag
event.description: Tag ids are never reused for the lifetime of this manager binding.

description.summary: end of an atomic tag-list update

event.name: toplevel_tags

description.summary: complete membership replacement for one toplevel

event.description: The tags array contains packed uint32 tag ids in compositor-defined order.
